[IERR.4.1.1] `ds_result_t.detail` is a `const char *` pointer.
Its lifetime is **at least until the next libds
call on the same engine**. Callers that need the
string beyond that point must copy it.

A call that acts on no engine ([IARC.1.11]), and a
`ds_engine_new` that fails and so leaves none, has no
engine to hold a built string: libds **must** return a
static detail from it, valid for the life of the
process.
